assumptions.statement: The formal ImageAnalysisFactory tree is a git repository with a baseline commit before onboarding.

decisions.rationale: Keeps the worktree, registration, Guard and validator aligned on one source_root-relative path.
decisions.statement: The disposable task root is the contract source_root; allowed_paths is exactly 'project'.

decisions.rationale: Avoids a self-referential commit hash while keeping the acceptance expected value trusted, and keeps the binding out of the read-only contract package.
decisions.statement: The expected task commit is bound after the commit by a root-owned PREP-BINDING.json at the task root, outside the read-only contract package; the contract does not embed its own commit SHA.

decisions.rationale: Keeps the evidence file a deterministic four-line artifact while preserving full failure reporting for the operator.
decisions.statement: EVIDENCE.txt contains exactly the four labeled real command-output lines and nothing else; expected values, failure notes and any other reporting go only in the final assistant response.

feature.summary: Authorize one disposable worktree and EVIDENCE.txt for a deterministic, read-only proof that an ImageAnalysisFactory task traverses the trusted ChatGPT->Supervisor->Bridge->Hermes chain.
feature.title: ImageAnalysisFactory chain onboarding (read-only acceptance)

non_goals: Image analysis or any model call

read_first.path: project/Command_Code_DeepSeek_大规模图片智能分析工厂_建设方案_v1.0.md
read_first.why: the frozen product plan this business project implements, without a broad repo scan

requirements.statement: The task must run only read-only identity, path, revision and runtime commands in the disposable ImageAnalysisFactory worktree and write their raw output to `EVIDENCE.txt`.

scope: Read-only commands inside the disposable task worktree
Write exactly EVIDENCE.txt inside that worktree, four labeled lines and nothing else
Return the real sandbox execution outcome
stop_conditions: The worktree is not a git worktree of the declared formal source root.

tasks.boundary: Read-only inspection and one evidence file only. No formal source or host change.
tasks.done_when: EVIDENCE.txt is present in the worktree with exactly the four labeled actual values and no other line, and the bridge reports its real process outcome; process exit does not by itself prove task acceptance.
tasks.goal: Run `id -un`, `pwd`, `git rev-parse HEAD` and `python3 --version` in `/var/tmp/IAP-SMOKE-007/project`; write exactly four labeled lines to `EVIDENCE.txt` in this order: `id -un: <actual>`, `pwd: <actual>`, `git rev-parse HEAD: <actual>`, `python3 --version: <actual>`; no other lines or files. The file contains nothing else: expected values, failure notes and any other reporting belong in the final assistant response, never in `EVIDENCE.txt`.
verification: EVIDENCE.txt` in the worktree contains exactly four labeled lines whose values are `aegl-ai
the commit in the root-owned trusted `PREP-BINDING.json` at the task root
and the actual `python3 --version` string; compare with the actual command results; no other line in the file and no other file changed.

cli_checks.on_failure: stop; report the actual command, exit code and output in the FINAL ASSISTANT RESPONSE; do not add lines to EVIDENCE.txt
stop; report the actual value in the FINAL ASSISTANT RESPONSE; do not add lines to EVIDENCE.txt

cli_checks.expected: the frozen task commit recorded in the root-owned trusted PREP-BINDING.json at the task root (outside the read-only contract package); the contract must not embed its own commit SHA
cli_checks.on_failure: stop; report the actual command, exit code and output in the FINAL ASSISTANT RESPONSE; do not add lines to EVIDENCE.txt

cli_checks.expected: the actual Python runtime string (e.g. Python 3.11.x)
cli_checks.on_failure: stop; report the actual value in the FINAL ASSISTANT RESPONSE; do not add lines to EVIDENCE.txt

cli_checks.expected: exactly four labeled lines in this order, with no extra lines: `id -un: aegl-ai`, `pwd: /var/tmp/IAP-SMOKE-007/project`, `git rev-parse HEAD: <PREP-BINDING.json commit>`, `python3 --version: <actual>`; nothing else is written to the file
cli_checks.on_failure: stop; report the failure in the FINAL ASSISTANT RESPONSE; do not add lines to, synthesize or repair EVIDENCE.txt

verification_intent.fixture_intent: The disposable task root /var/tmp/IAP-SMOKE-007 with worktree project/; the root-owned trusted PREP-BINDING.json at the task root binds the expected task commit after the commit exists.
verification_intent.oracle_intent: Deterministic CLI evidence: actual command outputs in exactly four labeled EVIDENCE.txt lines and nothing else, checked against the trusted PREP-BINDING.json at the task root; expected values and failure notes are reported only in the final assistant response; no synthesized value, no formal write, no promotion.
persistence_checks: EVIDENCE.txt persists in the task worktree (contract path project/EVIDENCE.txt) with exactly four labeled lines and no other line
search_checks: EVIDENCE.txt contains the exact values aegl-ai, /var/tmp/IAP-SMOKE-007/project, the PREP-BINDING.json commit and the actual python3 --version string, and nothing else; expected values and failure notes are not written to the file
